# The Western Store — Kurukshetra

> Premier women's ethnic, festive co-ord, and contemporary boutique fashion destination based in Kurukshetra, Haryana, India.

## About The Store
The Western Store is a physical boutique and pan-India online retailer offering handpicked Indian ethnic wear, designer festive co-ords, traditional anarkalis, festive drapes, and everyday contemporary silhouettes for women.

- **Website:** https://www.thewesternstore.in
- **Physical Address:** Opp. Hotel Pearl Marc, Railway Road, near Ujjivan Bank, Kurukshetra, Haryana - 136118, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp Helpline:** +91 97295 15288
- **Email:** thewesternstorekkr@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** 10:30 AM – 9:00 PM (Monday to Sunday)
- **Official Instagram:** https://instagram.com/the_western_store_kkr

## Core Collections
- **Designer Suits & Ensembles:** Hand-embellished anarkalis, chanderi silks, festive kurtis, and unstitched/stitched luxury suits.
- **Festive Co-ord Sets:** Modern silhouettes tailored from breathable rayon, organza, georgette, and pure cotton blends.
- **Bridal & Occasion Wear:** Statement wedding drapes, dupattas, and heavy festive partywear.
- **Budget Curations:** Dedicated collections tiered under ₹999, ₹1,499, ₹1,999, and ₹2,499.

## Service & Delivery
- **Shipping:** Pan-India express dispatch with tracking.
- **Ordering Methods:** Direct online checkout via Razorpay (UPI, Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking) and instant WhatsApp Concierge ordering.
- **Customer Redressal:** Transparent 7-day return/exchange assistance and direct WhatsApp photo/video consultation before dispatch.
